title: What If the Sun Disappeared Right Now? #shorts
description:
What would you do in those 8 minutes? 👇

If the Sun vanished, you wouldn't know for about 8 minutes and 20 seconds. Then the sky goes black, the Moon goes dark, Earth flies off in a straight line and the temperature crashes.
Life around deep-sea volcanic vents could keep going long after the rest of us.
#whatif #sun #space #science #shorts

beats.text: The Sun just disappeared. And you have no idea.
beats.speaker: girl

beats.text: Sunlight takes eight minutes and twenty seconds to reach us. So for eight minutes, everything looks normal.
beats.speaker: narrador

beats.text: The Moon's dark too. It only reflects the Sun.
beats.speaker: girl

beats.text: With nothing to hold it, Earth stops orbiting… and flies off in a straight line.
beats.speaker: narrador

beats.text: In a week, it's below zero Fahrenheit. In a year, minus one hundred.
beats.speaker: girl

beats.text: Plants stop making food. One by one, food chains collapse.
beats.speaker: narrador

beats.text: But deep in the ocean, life around hot volcanic vents could keep going for millions of years.
beats.speaker: narrador

analisis_gancho.que_gancho_usan: Funcionan las afirmaciones concretas que contradicen lo que crees; las amenazas genéricas ("destroy Earth") se quedan flojas.
analisis_gancho.funcionaria_aqui: Sí: el dato de los 8 minutos contradice la intuición ("lo notaría") y el chico lo verbaliza, así que no es repetir la premisa sino abrir un bucle. Se refuerza con una cuenta atrás 8:20 en pantalla.
